slug: 2026-05-20 Transforming lives in Benin a unique identification system

BEN.note: No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank says more than 7.7 million people have their NPI as of the end of May 2025, about 52% of the 14.8 million population (divided by the population given, not stated in the document).
The World Bank says nearly 99% of Benin's population is now biometrically enrolled.

BEN.note: No number at birth is stated.
Says only that ANIP is a partner in a World Bank financed project; no statement of who operates or owns the system.
Says WURI supports operationalising the Single Social Registry, but not that it is keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Benin has issued the Personal Identification Number (NPI) to more than 7.7 million people as of end May 2025, with the C'est Moi card issued through ANIP.
